EMRS Teaching/ Non Teaching Tier-II Result 2026

Post Date: August 8, 2026

11:27 am

EkLavya Model Residential School (EMRS) NESTS, will release the Tier-II Result on the official website for the recruitment of Teaching/ Non-Teaching Post. The Tier-II Exam was conducted from 22 to 25 March 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 28 October 2025. Candidates can check their Tier-II Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below. (Advt.No. NESTS/Adv/2025/01)
